name: Strawberry Water
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: ripe hulled berries
ingredients.originalText: one cupful of ripe hulled berries

ingredients.name: quarter of a pound of pulverized sugar
ingredients.originalText: a quarter of a pound of pulverized sugar

ingredients.name: cold water
ingredients.originalText: half a pint of cold water

ingredients.name: one and a half pints of cold water
ingredients.originalText: one and a half pints of cold water

instructions.text: Take one cupful of ripe hulled berries; crush with a wooden spoon, mixing with the mass a quarter of a pound of pulverized sugar and half a pint of cold water
Pour the mixture into a fine sieve, rub through and filter till clear
Add the strained juice of one lemon and one and a half pints of cold water, mix thoroughly and set in ice chest till wanted

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take one cupful of ripe hulled berries; crush with a wooden spoon, mixing with the mass a quarter of a pound of pulverized sugar and half a pint of cold water
2. Pour the mixture into a fine sieve, rub through and filter till clear
3. Add the strained juice of one lemon and one and a half pints of cold water, mix thoroughly and set in ice chest till wanted
